description:
Save a named X search clause to run with ``find_conversations``. Omit
``query_id`` to create; pass it to update in place — only the fields you pass
change, and a changed ``query`` resets the last-run watermark. ``weights``
holds only the scoring values you override. At most 50 saved queries per
npub; names are unique per npub. Free and owner-scoped. Returns
``{"success": true, "query": …}``.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

name.description:
The query's name, up to 120 characters and unique among your
queries. Required on create; blank on update keeps it.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

query.description:
The X search clause, up to 438 characters, with no ``?``
operator. Required on create; blank on update keeps it.

query_id.description: UUID of the query to update; blank creates a new one.

safe_defaults.description:
``true`` appends X's safe-default filters when the query
runs; null keeps the current value (and means ``true`` on create).

weights.description:
Scoring overrides to store, an object whose keys are any of
``need``, ``replies``, ``band``, ``spam``, ``reply``,
``replies_min``, ``followers_min``, ``followers_max``,
``decay_hours`` with integer values; null keeps the current ones.

name: excalibur_save_conversation_query
title: Save a conversation query
